source: Driver rivalries (see the GDD, 'Incidents, rivalries and storylines'). Each pair of drivers has a heat score. It rises with shared moments ('gains': finishing within 'closeFinishMs' of each other, and a head-to-head in the title fight), loses 'decay' of itself each round and never goes over 'ceiling'. 'levels' are the heat at which a pair becomes a Spark, a Rivalry and a Feud, and a Feud with 'legendarySeasons' seasons of history is Legendary. A rivalry ends when heat falls below 'endBelow', and a driver may have 'cap' live rivalries. 'fanMultipliers' scale the fans a driver wins in a final that a rival also races.
